items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the ankheg), reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).

items.name: Acid Spray
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. On a failed save, 14 (4d6) Acid damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Tunneler
items.notes: The ankheg can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The devil makes one Claws attack and one Tail attack, or it makes two Hurl Flame attacks.

items.name: Claws
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from both claws.

items.name: Tail
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

items.name: Hurl Flame
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts burning.

items.name: Barbed Hide
items.notes: At the start of each of its turns, the devil deals 5 (1d10) Piercing damage to any creature it is grappling or any creature grappling it.

items.name: Diabolical Restoration
items.notes: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The devil makes one Beard attack and one Infernal Glaive attack.

items.name: Beard
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil's next turn. Until this poison ends, the target can't regain Hit Points.

items.name: Infernal Glaive
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a creature and doesn't already have an infernal wound, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution saving throw DC 12. On a failed save, the target receives an infernal wound. While wounded, the target loses 5 (1d10) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Club
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Training
items.notes: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.

items.name: Agile
items.notes: The rat doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

items.name: Death Burst
items.notes: The rat explodes when it dies. Constitution saving throw DC 9, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the rat. On a failed save, 1 Acid damage.

items.name: Ritual Sickle
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d4 + 2 Slashing damage plus 1 Necrotic damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Dardew makes two attacks, using Fiery Claw or Power Chord in any combination.

items.name: Fiery Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

items.name: Power Chord
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 14, one creature Dardew can see within 120 ft. On a failed save, 13 (3d6 + 3) Thunder damage.

items.name: Silver Tongue
items.notes: Charisma saving throw DC 14, one creature Dardew can see within 60 feet. On a failed save The creature has the Charmed condition until the start of Dardew's next turn.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by a Demobat), reach 5 ft.  Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

items.name: Tentacles
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from all four tentacles.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The demodog has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the demodog's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The demodragon makes two Bite attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

items.name: Acid Breath
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. On a failed save, 22 (4d10) Acid damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Baleful Presence
items.notes: Sources of light in a 120-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the demodragon flicker wildly. Nonmagical sources of Bright Light in that area instead shed Dim Light.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: The demodragon regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The spawn makes two Claw attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). While Grappled, the target has the Blinded condition.

items.name: Baleful Presence
items.notes: Sources of light in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the spawn flicker wildly. Nonmagical sources of Bright Light in that area instead shed Dim Light.

items.name: Regeneration
items.notes: The spawn regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

items.name: Running Leap
items.notes: With a 10-foot running start, the spawn can Long Jump up to 30 feet.

name: Dretch
languages: Abyssal; telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

items.name: Fetid Cloud
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation [Area of Effect] originating from the dretch. On a failed save, The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned, the creature can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

items.name: Dazzling Confetti
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Radiant damage.

items.name: Vanishing Trick
items.notes: Flizzlebin has the Invisible condition for 10 minutes. This effect ends early immediately after Flizzlebin makes an attack roll, deals damage, or has the Incapacitated condition, or if his hat is removed.

items.name: Distracting Glitter
items.notes: Flizzlebin is hit by an attack roll. Flizzlebin adds 2 to his AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: Flizzlebin has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Ventriloquist
items.notes: Flizzlebin can project his voice from anywhere within 1 mile of himself.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, Reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Acid damage.

items.name: Death Burst
items.notes: The rat explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the rat. On a failed save, 5 (2d4) Acid damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Web
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 13, one creature the spider can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, the target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).

items.name: Spider Climb
items.notes: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

items.name: Web Walker
items.notes: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

items.name: Rend
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: Bone Bow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Rampage
items.notes: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

items.name: Scimitar
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

items.name: Shortbow
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.

items.name: Nimble Escape
items.notes: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.

items.name: Spear
items.notes: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

items.name: Fire Breath
items.notes: Dexterity saving throw DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. On a failed save, 17 (5d6) Fire damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Pack Tactics
items.notes: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Sting
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 Piercing damage plus 2d6 Poison damage.

items.name: Invisibility
items.notes: The imp has the Invisible condition for 1 minute. This effect ends early immediately after the imp makes an attack roll or deals damage, or if the imp has the Incapacitated condition.

items.name: Shape-Shift
items.notes: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

items.name: Magic Resistance
items.notes: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

items.name: Rancid Knife
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of Korex's next turn.

items.name: Entrancing Pipes
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 12, one creature Korex can see within 120 feet. On a failed save 14 (4d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of Korex's next turn. On a successful save Half damage only.

items.name: Skitter
items.notes: Korex takes the Dash or Disengage action.

items.name: Sewer Speech
items.notes: Korex can comprehend and verbally communicate with Monstrosities.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

items.name: Snake Hair
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Poison Ray
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +5 to hit, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.

items.name: Petrifying Gaze
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. On a failed save, The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a failed save, The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.

items.name: Slam
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.

items.name: Pacifying Spores
items.notes: Constitution saving throw DC 11, one creature the myconid can see within 10 feet. On a failed save, The target has the Stunned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: Rapport Spores
items.notes: The myconid expels spores in a 30-foot Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area with an Intelligence score of 2 or higher that aren't Constructs, Elementals, or Undead gain telepathy with a range of 30 feet for 1 hour.

items.name: Sun Sickness
items.notes: While in sunlight, the myconid has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. The myconid dies if it spends more than 1 hour in sunlight.

items.name: Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.

items.name: Needles
items.notes: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Piercing damage.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: Rilly June makes two Hayfork attacks.

items.name: Hayfork
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

items.name: G'wan, Git!
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 11, one creature Rilly June can see within 60 feet. On a failed save, 10 (3d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, Half damage only.

items.name: Fearsome Claw
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.

items.name: Terrifying Glare
items.notes: Wisdom saving throw DC 11, one creature the scarecrow can see within 30 feet. On a failed save, The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While Frightened, the target has the Paralyzed condition.

items.name: Draining Swipe
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target's Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

items.name: Shadow Stealth
items.notes: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

items.name: Amorphous
items.notes: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

items.name: Sunlight Weakness
items.notes: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

items.name: Shriek
items.notes: A creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies.

items.name: Bite
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, Reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 2) Piercing damage or 1d4 + 2 Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.

items.name: Death Burst
items.notes: The rat explodes when it dies. Constitution saving throw DC 10, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the rat. On a failed save, 2d4 Acid Damage. On a successful save, Half damage.

items.name: Swarm
items.notes: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain Hit Points.

items.name: Constricting Vine
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 2 Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) from one of three vines.

items.name: Entangling Vines
items.notes: Grasping vines momentarily appear on each enemy in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point of the blight's choice within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition until the start of the blight's next turn.

items.name: Multiattack
items.notes: The fungus makes two Rotting Touch attacks.

items.name: Rotting Touch
items.notes: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 10 ft. Hit: 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
